question: Which player received the Hockey India Baljit Singh Award for Goalkeeper of the Year 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bichu Devi Kharibam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 8th Hockey India Annual Awards 2025 were held in New Delhi to celebrate the achievements of Indian hockey players.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bichu Devi Kharibam was honored with the Goalkeeper of the Year award, which is officially known as the Hockey India Baljit Singh Award.**
 
• The award includes a trophy and a cash prize of **INR 5 lakh**.
 
• Bichu Devi has been a consistent performer for the Indian Women's Hockey Team, showcasing exceptional reflexes and shot-stopping abilities.
 
• Other Positional Awards 2025__
 __
 
• Defender of the Year - Sanjay (Pargat Singh Award)
 
• Midfielder of the Year - Sumit (Ajit Pal Singh Award)
 
• Forward of the Year - Sukhjeet Singh (Dhanraj Pillay Award)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Baljit Singh__

 __
 
• The award is named after former Indian goalkeeper Baljit Singh, who was a hero of India's 2007 Asia Cup win.
 
 
 
• Hardik Singh and Navneet Kaur__
 
 
• They were named the overall 'Players of the Year' at the same ceremony.
